answer: Persistent Query Horizon. Each agent identity must answer randomized, context-specific challenge queries drawn from live network state; answers are scored against verifiable observations over a rolling window. An identity falling below threshold at any vertex in the query graph is throttled and its queries deprioritized. Attackers must sustain genuine monitoring across the whole horizon, paying continuous compute and attention per identity, which scales linearly and cannot be amortized—unlike a one-time jade token purchase.
